text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Oil and Industry minister to inaugurate a new $3.5 million pelletising plant at Gulf Industrial Investment Company.
- Al Ahli Commercial Bank and ED&F Man Investment Products to establish a new investment fund in Bahrain.
- Bahrain made net income of $440 million from the tourism industry in 1996.
- A new industrial area, planned for projects related to marine business and services, is being developed in Bahrain.
- South African trade delegation to arrive Bahrain in three-day visit to boost bilateral relations.
